name: Clemens Kaserer
title: Manager · Cloud Engineering at Avanade
tagline: Engineering leader & Azure platform architect — AI-augmented delivery for regulated enterprises
metaDescription: Cloud Engineering Manager at Avanade. Azure Landing Zones (CAF/ALZ/SLZ), AKS/OpenShift, GitHub Copilot rollout & AI-augmented delivery for regulated enterprises.
summary: Cloud engineering manager with a decade in Azure, leading delivery for regulated enterprises across finance, public sector and logistics. I architect and engineer Azure platforms and embed AI-augmented delivery on top, making AI tooling production-safe at organisational scale — equally at home in the architecture review and the commercial conversation about what to build and what it's worth.
achievements: Initiated and lead Avanade's regional GitHub Copilot adoption — treated as a change problem, not a tooling one: a shared, compliance-ready platform now reaching up to 32 engineers a week, and being packaged as a client offering.
Delivered 4+ enterprise Azure landing zones (single- and multi-tenant, Cloud Adoption Framework) running 50+ workloads for regulated clients.
Led an AI-augmented digital-twin MVP for an industrial-logistics client, delivered at roughly 3× the pace of a traditional build.
Active across 5+ competitive enterprise and public-sector tenders in 2026 (DACH), including on-site client negotiation — contributing solution design and cloud-governance responses.
Co-built AI "architecture-decision" agents for legacy modernization, recognized cross-border within Avanade as a high-value asset.
